description:
An app inspector for use with an Appium server


(note: earlier 2026.11.x versions are plugin-only and are functionally identical)
Highlights
- Security fixes. Updating is recommended
- Added templates in Saved Capability Sets for easier session creation
- Added history in element search
- Added keyboard shortcuts (opening element search, refreshing the source/screenshot, toggling recording)
- Added ability to configure the app source tree expansion depth per-click
- Added display switcher in the app header for iPhone Duo usage (XCUITest driver only)
- Added support for more locator strategies (Espresso/WinCore drivers)
What's Changed
🚀 New Features
- feat: support the Sauce Labs asia-south-2 data center by @bahrimootaz in #3218
- feat: enable display switcher for XCUITest on iOS by @eglitise in #3242
- feat: rely on getPressableButtons for XCUITest pressButton values by @eglitise in #3268 and #3288
- feat: add history to element locator search by @hoanle0126 in #3269
- feat: add capability templates to Saved Capability Sets by @pythonyx135793 and @eglitise in #3276 and #3307
- feat: configure source expansion depth by @pythonyx135793 in #3271
- feat: add keyboard shortcuts for Inspector session controls by @pythonyx135793 in #3275
- feat: update supported strategies & drivers in search & recorder by @eglitise in #3330
🎨 Design Changes
- style: update Siri icon by @eglitise in #3208
- style: adjust spacing for Sauce SSL checkbox by @eglitise in #3291
- style: hide empty selection column in certain tables by @eglitise in #3297
- style: tune capability list footer by @eglitise in #3333
🛠 Fixes
- fix: remove webview top offset for iPhone Duo closed state by @eglitise in #3240
- fix: generate valid client code for null values and non-identifier keys by @theluckystrike in #3220
- fix: use newer endpoint for retrieving session capabilities by @eglitise in #3257
- fix: update BrowserStack logo by @eglitise in #3302
- fix: check UiAutomator selector uniqueness across all element classes by @RaphaelFakhri in #3306
- fix: tune recent features + docs by @eglitise in #3310
🛡️ Security Fixes
- Plugin/web version only: the ?state= URL parameter is no longer supported for the built-in cloud providers, and requires providing the full state instead of merging with the current state: GHSA-8c9c-rxhv-j84m
- Sauce Labs connections now always use HTTPS, and the Sauce Connect proxy now allows specifying HTTP or HTTPS: GHSA-7qj5-fxr3-h4fh
- Code generation is more resilient against untrusted values: GHSA-6jwm-6grq-xrcw
📖 Documentation
- docs: update driver links by @eglitise in #3250
- docs: update docs for search history by @eglitise in #3298
- docs: tune CORS-related info by @eglitise in #3329
🌐 Localization
- chore: Update translations by @github-actions[bot] in #3229, #3247, #3265, #3292, and #3318
🔍 Other Changes

- ci: configure Azure OIDC signing for Windows by @eglitise in #3196
- ci: configure macOS notarization by @eglitise in #3237
- chore: refactor driver specific control buttons by @eglitise in #3241
